title: Inguinal hernia repair (Lichtenstein)
summary: A tension-free mesh repair of a right inguinal hernia.

anchors.name: right_groin
anchors.label: right groin, above the inguinal ligament

steps.title: Plug the diathermy generator into the pendant
steps.hint: Mains lead from the generator into a socket on the ceiling pendant.

steps.title: Where does the patient plate go?
steps.prompt: Where should the return electrode (patient plate) be placed?

choices.text: On a well-perfused muscle mass close to the operation, such as the thigh, on dry hair-free skin
choices.feedback: Correct: a large, well-perfused contact area keeps the current density low.
Poor contact: a burn risk at the plate.

steps.title: Apply the patient plate to the thigh
steps.hint: Full, flat contact on the thigh; check the generator's contact alarm clears.

steps.title: WHO Time Out
steps.prompt: Before skin incision for a right inguinal hernia repair, the team pauses. What must be confirmed aloud?

choices.text: Patient identity, the procedure, the site and side, and antibiotics given in the last 60 minutes
choices.feedback: Correct: the Time Out confirms who, what and where, and that prophylaxis is in.

choices.text: Only that the consent form is signed
choices.feedback: The signature alone does not prevent wrong-site surgery.

choices.text: Nothing: the site was marked on the ward
choices.feedback: Marking does not replace the Time Out.

steps.hint: The site is the right groin. All three phases of the WHO checklist are mandatory.

steps.title: Pick up the skin preparation
steps.hint: Alcoholic chlorhexidine, applied from the incision site outwards.

steps.title: Prepare the skin over the right groin
steps.hint: Centre outwards, wider than the incision; let it dry fully before drapes and diathermy (it is flammable).

steps.title: Take the scalpel
steps.hint: Incision 2 cm above and parallel to the medial two thirds of the inguinal ligament.

steps.title: Incise the right groin
steps.hint: Wrong side is a never event: check the mark.

steps.title: Place the self-retaining retractor
steps.hint: Opens the wound without an assistant.

steps.title: Protect the nerve
steps.prompt: Which nerve lies on the spermatic cord and must be protected?

choices.feedback: It is below the inguinal ligament.

steps.title: Classify the hernia
steps.prompt: The sac emerges lateral to the inferior epigastric vessels. It is…

choices.feedback: Direct hernias are medial to the vessels.
Femoral hernias are below the ligament.

steps.title: Reduce the sac and lay the mesh on the posterior wall
steps.hint: Mesh to the inguinal ligament inferiorly, conjoint tendon medially, slit round the cord.

steps.title: Close the external oblique and skin; final count
